subject.title: fix(gateway): make WebChat history text cap configurable

question: Should OpenClaw support `gateway.chatHistoryTextMaxChars` as a global persisted config field for WebChat/Control UI history projection, with a maximum of 500,000 characters?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but current docs and recent history intentionally moved WebChat toward bounded history plus `chat.message.get`, so code review cannot decide the permanent public config contract alone.

options.title: Accept the global config field
options.body: Merge after confirming the field name, scope, documentation, and 500,000-character ceiling are the intended supported contract.

options.title: Request a narrower policy
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for a smaller ceiling, different config location, or more explicit operator warning before merge.

options.title: Keep bounded history only
options.body: Close or rework the PR if maintainers want users to rely on `chat.message.get` instead of raising history payload caps globally.

recommendation.title: Accept the global config field
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the field name, scope, documentation, and 500,000-character ceiling are the intended supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits and issue discussion show this person most directly shaped the current WebChat no-persisted-config and full-message-reader product boundary.
